[SWS_CM_12007] New data samples received by
CM
at execution time of receive
handler
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00203
⌈
In case new data samples arrive at Communication Management side during the exe-
cution of a user defined receive handler, Communication Management shall postpone
the next call to receive handler until the previous call to receive handler is finished.
⌋
